parsed.rationale: All 11 members are unnamed extensions (name: "") on `EnvironmentValues` spread across 5 distinct packages — AppServices, Playback, WXUI, Wallpaper, and PlayerHeaderView — each injecting domain-specific keys (playlist service, review-request service, radio player controller, playback controller, overlay sheet, blend modes, theme state, accent color, etc.). This is the standard SwiftUI pattern for adding custom `EnvironmentValues` keys: each feature module must declare its own extension in its own package to keep modules decoupled. Consolidating them would either create an unacceptable cross-package dependency or require a single monolithic environment-key file that defeats the modular architecture. The structural signal is purely coincidental — the extensions share the extended type name but encode entirely unrelated domain concepts.
